methods.saved_fixture_metadata: Read ZIP member names and Document.xml metadata without loading FreeCAD. Company, CreatedBy, LastModifiedBy, Comment and Meta are empty; retained native mesh-generation provenance contains literal software-QA paths/hashes, not runtime payloads or user-profile settings.

limitations: This review does not replace the parent's all-95-file exact stored/decoded hash, size, set-coverage and source/role provenance audit.
